Exmouth Market.fact: The south-east corner of the street was the site for the London Spa which dates back to 1730 and is one of Clerkenwell's most famous resorts. It was rebuilt several times and called the London Spa until 2002.

Exocytosis.subject: Environment & Ecology
Exocytosis.question: The _____ was Active transport and bulk transport in which a cell transports molecules out of the cell.
Exocytosis.fact: Exocytosis () is a form of active transport in which a cell transports molecules (e.g., neurotransmitters and proteins) out of the cell. As an active transport mechanism, exocytosis requires the use of energy to transport material.

Exocytosis.subject: Environment & Ecology
Exocytosis.question: In neurons and endocrine cells, the _____ proteins and SM-proteins catalyze the fusion by forming a complex that brings the two fusion membranes together
Exocytosis.fact: In neurons and endocrine cells, the SNARE proteins and SM-proteins catalyze the fusion by forming a complex that brings the two fusion membranes together. For instance, in synapses, the SNARE complex is formed by syntaxin-1 and SNAP25 at the plasma membrane and VAMP2 at the vesicle membrane.

Exocytosis.subject: Environment & Ecology
Exocytosis.question: In mammals, exocyst components localize in both plasma membrane, and _____ apparatus and the exocyst proteins are colocalized at the fusion point of the post-Golgi vesicles
Exocytosis.fact: In mammals, exocyst components localize in both plasma membrane, and Golgi apparatus and the exocyst proteins are colocalized at the fusion point of the post-Golgi vesicles.

Exocytosis.subject: Environment & Ecology
Exocytosis.question: For example, vesicles that transport proteins from the _____ apparatus to the cell surface area, will be likely to use motor proteins and a cytoskeletal track to get closer to their target
Exocytosis.fact: For example, vesicles that transport proteins from the Golgi apparatus to the cell surface area, will be likely to use motor proteins and a cytoskeletal track to get closer to their target. Before tethering would have been appropriate, many of the proteins used for the active transport would have been instead set for passive transport, because the Golgi apparatus does not require ATP to transport proteins.

Exostosis.question: The _____ was Formation of new bone on a bone.
Exostosis.fact: Occasionally, an exostosis can be potentially life-threatening. When used in the phrases "cartilaginous exostosis" or "osteocartilaginous exostosis", the term is considered synonymous with osteochondroma.
